svg.title: Default form register
svg.text: All 26 defaults: 24 active forms and two reserved forms. Template v3 is distinct from each controlled paper revision.
Default seed + current CI3 service rules | Editable source included | See accuracy notes
Minimum one row per required group on submit. No PPM-025 is present. The 26th default is WH-STOCK-RELEASE. Duplicate form titles retain their distinct codes.
